title: Variables in one 'Set multiple variables' module cannot reference each other
symptoms: A variable built from a sibling variable in the same module comes out empty
cause: All variables in a single Set multiple variables module are computed from the module's inputs at once, so none can see the others.
fix: Compute each variable from the original source fields, or chain two modules.
apply: In every variable's formula map {{1.summary}} directly instead of a sibling variable.
